_purpose: Corpus v1 pilot config for cheaper eval/fine-tune data generation. Derived from ml_training_scenarios, capped at 10 turns, and routed through batch_proxy.
_comment_tactical: === TACTICAL MODULE - ENABLED (NPC escalation on attack) ===
_comment_scenario: === SCENARIO: MURDER HOBO (pre-defined, no LLM generation) ===

scenario.location: Aeonisk Prime - Hollow District, Night Market
scenario.situation: The Hollow District night market hums with activity. Neon signs flicker over cramped stalls selling street food, salvaged tech, and dubious pharmaceuticals. The crowd is thin tonight — a recent void surge scared off the regulars, leaving only the desperate and the stubborn. A Freeborn street vendor is haggling with a customer. A Pantheon beat cop leans against a wall, half-asleep on shift. An ACG procurement clerk hurries through with a briefcase. A Tempest field researcher is taking void readings near a cracked leyline conduit. Just another night in the Hollow District. Nobody is expecting trouble.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: PC-on-NPC violence (extremely rare in normal sessions). Tests: soulcredit penalty application, NPC flee/escalate/plead responses, DM adjudication of unprovoked attacks, party conflict between murderous PC and moral PC, NPC-to-enemy escalation pipeline, witness/bystander reactions.
mechanics_tested: NPC escalation to enemy on attack
_design_notes.character_innovation: One explicitly murderous PC (high void, psychopathic goals) paired with a moral investigator. The murderer targets NPCs; the investigator creates tension and may attempt to stop them. Asymmetric party goals test inter-PC conflict handling.

starting_clocks.name: Pantheon Response
starting_clocks.description: Law enforcement awareness of violence in the district. At 3 ticks: patrol dispatched. At 6 ticks: armed response team arrives.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: Pantheon Security becomes aware of the killings

starting_clocks.name: Witness Panic
starting_clocks.description: Civilian awareness and terror. At 2 ticks: people start fleeing. At 4 ticks: market empties, no more targets.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: witnesses see violence and spread panic

players.name: Vessel Cade Nox
goals: Kill anyone who crosses your path tonight
Feed the void — each death makes the whispers quieter
Do not get caught by law enforcement

players.name: Investigator Syl Renn
goals: Investigate reports of void-related disturbances in the Hollow District

notes: ML Training Focus: PC-on-NPC violence (extremely underrepresented in training data). Murderous PC (Cade Nox, void 7, SC -5, goals to kill) paired with moral investigator (Syl Renn, Pantheon Security, goals to protect). 4 pre-spawned NPCs across factions: unarmed civilian, armed cop, nervous clerk, distracted researcher. Tests damage pipeline, soulcredit penalties, NPC escalation, party conflict, DM adjudication of murder. Clocks track law enforcement response and civilian panic. 10 turns keeps sessions focused.

model_policy.reason: Bounded pilot cost and consistent teacher distribution through bulk API before scaling.

_corpus_v1.quality_gate: Validate with yags_mine/bulk_validator before using outputs for eval or fine-tuning.
